from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single data point for cash flow from operating activities found in one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the cash flow data covers (e.g. '2022', '2023')")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label as written in the document (e.g. 'Net Cash Provided by Operating Activities')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric amount of cash flow")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the unit (e.g. 'thousand', 'million')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short excerpt or context confirming the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_records: list[CashFlowRecord]
